summary: Drugs Made In America Acquisition Corp., a blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting shareholder approval of an extension amendment at an extraordinary general meeting. The extension allows up to twelve one-month postponements of the business combination deadline from April 29, 2026 to April 29, 2027, contingent on the sponsor depositing the lesser of $300,000 or $0.04 per non-redeemed public share per month into the trust account. This is a routine SPAC extension vote, not a special-situation event like a business combination announcement, termination, or liquidation. No deal terms, premiums, or advisor details are present. The filing solely concerns procedural charter amendment and shareholder vote results.
